Physical Sheltering +33: +33 Enhancement bonus to Physical Resistance Rating
Insightful Doublestrike 6%: Passive: 6% Insight bonus to Doublestrike. (Doublestrike is a chance to score an additional hit with a melee attack.)
Druidic Stoneshape: While in Wild Shape, you receive a Primal bonus to PRR equal to half the number of Wilderness Lore feats you have.

Adherent of the Mists Set (Legendary): 5 Pieces Equipped:+30 Profane bonus to Physical Resistance Rating+30 Profane bonus to Positive, Negative, and Repair Amplification+15 Profane bonus to Melee and Ranged Power+15 Profane bonus to Universal Spell Power
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
